pairs.why: Both are nearly the same render; the brighter radar sweep on B doesn't change the look, and both are equally cool grey and plain next to the warm, saturated, chunky real cards.
The two are almost pixel-identical except the sweep angle, so neither is closer, and both share the same grey, low-color finish.
B only adds radar blips, which is a content detail rather than a change in rendering, shape or light, so the two are equally close.
A only adds radar blips; the body, material and lighting match B, so neither reads more like the real cards.
B's thin base plinth is a small construction change that is neither more nor less like the real cards, and the finish is the same in both.
A's plinth base is the only difference and it doesn't move the look toward the real cards' saturated, chunky toy forms.
B's panel screws are a tiny detail change, and rendering, color and light are the same in both.
A's panel screws are a tiny detail change, and both have the same cool grey finish that is far from the warm real cards.
